verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document an AI feature inside the Statsig console that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The MCP server lets external AI clients (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT) query Statsig data, but the AI runs in those third-party tools, not in the product, so it is adjacent at best. The other AI items cover the user's own LLM apps (prompt experiments, offline evals) or non-AI statistical automation (Autotune, power analysis), and none of these is AI-generated insight from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
